lines.en: label wakanaspring1:
scene bedroom_day
It was a normal day, just like any other.
lines.zh: 这本是平常的一天，跟别的日子没什么两样。

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim1
Until it wasn’t.
lines.zh: 直到它不再平常。

lines.en: : This is really not the BGM track I want to hear this early in the morning.
lines.zh: : 这大清早的，我真不想听见这种 BGM。

lines.en: : Imani. Seize him.
lines.zh: : Imani。把他拿下。

lines.en: : Wakana, don’t you think we should maybe {i}talk{/i} about this first? Senpai clearly just woke up and-
lines.zh: : Wakana，你不觉得我们该先{i}谈{/i}谈吗？前辈明显刚睡醒，而且——

lines.en: : Absolutely not. Seize him now.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行。现在就把他拿下。

lines.en: : Uhh...Dad? What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 呃……爸爸？这是怎么回事？

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim2
: What?! Shouldn’t we be asking {i}you{/i} that question?! Why you callin’ this man “Dad” all of a sudden?! The hell happened while you two’ve been cooped up in here?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！该问这话的不是我们吗？！{i}你{/i}怎么突然管这男人叫「爸爸」了？！你俩关在这屋里到底发生了什么狗血事？！

lines.en: : A lot, actually.
lines.zh: : 其实发生了挺多的。

lines.en: : Arakawa Junior, stop that. This man is not your father and has likely just brainwashed you into believing he is.
lines.zh: : 荒川二世，别说了。这男人不是你父亲，他多半只是给你洗了脑，让你以为他是。

lines.en: : Don’t listen to them, Ami. They won’t get it.
lines.zh: : 别听她们的，Ami。她们不会懂的。

lines.en: : See? He’s doing it right now.
lines.zh: : 看吧？他现在就在洗。

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim3

: Actually, Sensei’s been standing in for my dad for a really long time now and the two of us decided it would be best if we finally took our relationship to the next level because of our undying love for one another.
lines.zh: : 其实 Sensei 顶替我爸的位置已经很久了，我俩决定，既然我们对彼此的爱至死不渝，是时候把这段关系再推上一阶了。

lines.en: : Did you really have to word it like that?
lines.zh: : 你非得这么措辞不可吗？

lines.en: : Imani, seize him before I gag.
lines.zh: : Imani，在我吐出来之前把他拿下。

lines.en: : Oh! So like, normal dad. Not sex dad.
lines.zh: : 哦！原来是……普通爸爸。不是那种爸爸。

lines.en: : He can be any kind of dad he wants and I would never think to refuse him because I am a good girl.
lines.zh: : 他想当哪种爸爸都行，我绝不会拒绝他，因为我是个好女孩。

lines.en: : Can we forget about all of the fatherhood stuff and get to the bottom of why you two have stormed into my house trying to “seize me?”
lines.zh: : 我们能先把「当爹」这套放一边，说清楚你俩冲进我家要「拿下我」到底是为了什么吗？

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim4
: Not until you have been properly seized. Doing so beforehand gives you the opportunity to refuse.
lines.zh: : 在你被正式拿下之前不行。提前说，就等于给你拒绝的机会。

lines.en: : I think you’re being kidnapped.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你是要被绑架了。

lines.en: : You are. And I’m the muscle. But seeing as you definitely don’t want to come...let’s go, Wakana! Time to leave!
lines.zh: : 没错。我就是那个打手。不过既然你明显不想来……我们走吧，Wakana！该撤了！

lines.en: : Go {i}where?{/i} Because if you’re here to drag me back to school, you should probably do it on a day where there actually {i}is{/i} school.
lines.zh: : 去{i}哪儿{/i}？如果你们是来把我拖回学校的，那最好挑个真的{i}有{/i}课的日子。

lines.en: : The only {i}school{/i} you need to be concerned about right now is a school of fish.
lines.zh: : 眼下你唯一需要操心的{i}「群」{/i}，是一群鱼。

lines.en: : ...What?
: Get in the car, you pathetic excuse for a man. We’re going to the beach.
lines.zh: : 上车，你这丢人现眼的男人。我们要去海边。

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim5
: Wait, is it really time for the class beach trip already? Have I been gone that long?
lines.zh: : 等等，班级海边旅行已经到了？我消失了那么久吗？

lines.en: : No. {i}Your{/i} trip isn’t for another few weeks. This trip is for staff members only. And also Osako because she is my plus-one.
lines.zh: : 不。{i}你{/i}们班的旅行还要再过几周。这趟只有教职工能去。外加 Osako，因为她是我的携伴。

lines.en: : By “staff members” she really means just us. No one else from the school is coming.
lines.zh: : 她说的「教职工」其实就是我们几个。学校没别人来。

lines.en: : Well...can Ami be {i}my{/i} plus-one then?
lines.zh: : 那……Ami 能当{i}我的{/i}携伴吗？

lines.en: : No. She’ll ruin everything.
lines.zh: : 不行。她会把一切都毁了。

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim6
: It’s sad because it’s true.
lines.zh: : 可悲之处在于，这是事实。

lines.en: : Hey! Cheer up, Ami! At least you have a dad again. That’s more than like half the class can say.
lines.zh: : 嘿！开心点，Ami！至少你又有爸爸了。这可比班上大概一半的人都强。

lines.en: : Please don’t joke with her like that. And please leave if you’re not going to let me bring her along.
lines.zh: : 请别拿她开这种玩笑。而且要是不让她跟着，就请你们走吧。

lines.en: : Please stop your moaning and be seized already. I don’t have the energy for this.
lines.zh: : 别抱怨了，乖乖被拿下吧。我没力气跟你耗。

lines.en: : Wakana-
lines.zh: : Wakana——

lines.en: : Dad, it’s fine. You can go without me, I won’t be jealous.
lines.zh: : 爸爸，没事的。你不用带我也能去，我不会吃醋。

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim7
: Well, actually, I {i}will.{/i} But there’s not really anything I can do about it and I feel bad that you’ll be staying back just for me.
lines.zh: : 好吧，其实我{i}会{/i}吃醋。但我也没办法，而且你为了我留下来，我会过意不去。

lines.en: : Stop growing up so quickly. I’ve only been a dad for a couple weeks.
lines.zh: : 别长得这么快。我才当了几个星期的爸爸。

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim8
: But you’ll still be one for the rest of forever so it doesn’t even matter!
lines.zh: : 但你会当一辈子爸爸，所以根本没关系！

lines.en: : What now, Arakawa Senior? You no longer have a reason to refuse.
lines.zh: : 现在怎么说，荒川前辈？你没有理由拒绝了。

lines.en: : Wakana-
lines.zh: : Wakana——

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim7
: Just go. It’ll be fun.
lines.zh: : 去吧。会很好玩的。

lines.en: : Only for one night, though. Any longer than that and you might come back to a bald daughter.
lines.zh: : 不过只能去一晚。再久一点，你回来时可能就有个秃头女儿了。

lines.en: scene black
: Ugh...fine.
lines.zh: : 唉……好吧。

lines.en: : Imani, seize him.
lines.zh: : Imani，把他拿下。

lines.en: : Is the seizing really necessary if he agrees to come quietly?...
lines.zh: : 他都答应乖乖走了，还非得「拿下」不可吗？……

lines.en: Somehow or another, I wind up getting roped into a second spontaneous and adult-focused outing after just having gone camping with Sara and company a little while ago.
lines.zh: 不知怎么的，就在前不久刚跟 Sara 她们去露营之后，我又被拉进了第二场说走就走的成年人出游。

lines.en: However, that trip featured a lot of “building me up” since that group of friends has always been extremely supportive of me for some reason.
lines.zh: 不过那趟旅行的主题是「把我夸上天」——因为那群朋友不知为何一向极度支持我。

lines.en: This trip, I imagine, will involve a heavy dose of Wakana belittling me while Imani secretly prays for me to fuck her once everyone else goes to sleep. So suffice it to say, I think it’ll be a little less poignant.
lines.zh: 而这一趟，我猜会是大剂量的 Wakana 贬损我，同时 Imani 暗自祈祷等别人睡了我能跟她上床。所以可以这么说：我想这趟会没那么动人。

lines.en: But...it {i}has{/i} been a while since I’ve spent time with them. And humoring them with my presence (which shouldn’t be wanted in the first place), is the least I can do.
lines.zh: 不过……我{i}确实{/i}有一阵子没跟她们待在一起了。用我的存在（这本就不该被需要）去哄她们开心，也算是我最起码能做的事。

lines.en: Also, in case you were wondering, the “car” Wakana referenced winds up being a taxi since none of us actually possess a vehicle.
lines.zh: 另外，你要是好奇：Wakana 说的那辆「车」最后是一辆出租车，因为我们其实都没车。

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim9
{b}WHICH IS GREAT BECAUSE I’LL NEVER BE ABLE TO DRIVE ONE{/b}
lines.zh: {b}这真好，因为我永远也开不了车{/b}

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim10
: So are all of the rooms at this inn just identical or?...
lines.zh: : 所以这家旅馆的房间都是一个样的，还是……？

lines.en: : We bought the “plus package” so the room came with alcohol this time.
lines.zh: : 我们买了「加强套餐」，所以这次房间自带酒水。

lines.en: : And if all goes according to plan you’ll {i}also{/i} be getting a “plus package” by the end of the night.
lines.zh: : 而且如果一切顺利，今晚结束前你{i}也{/i}能拿到一份「加强套餐」。

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim11
: Hahaha! I’m going to kill you!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！我要宰了你！

lines.en: : Is it even okay for you to be drinking with your new medication?
lines.zh: : 你吃着新药还喝酒，真的没问题吗？

lines.en: : I doubt there will be any side effects from drinking just a little. And it doesn’t seem like the inn gave us much in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我只喝一点点，应该不会有什么副作用。而且旅馆给的似乎本来就不多。

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim12
: Wakana, there are like thirty beers and a bottle of champagne there.
lines.zh: : Wakana，那儿有差不多三十瓶啤酒和一瓶香槟。

lines.en: : Yes, and that’s only seven beers and about a glass or two for each of us.
lines.zh: : 是啊，摊下来也就每人七瓶啤酒、一两杯香槟。

lines.en: : We’ll still have two beers left over at that rate.
lines.zh: : 照这么算，我们还会剩两瓶啤酒。

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim13
: Wonderful job, Arakawa. At this rate, you’ll be ready to start teaching again in no time at all and Imani won’t have to break her back cleaning up after you anymore.
lines.zh: : 干得漂亮，荒川。照这个速度，你很快就能重返讲台了，Imani 也不必再替你收拾烂摊子累断腰。

lines.en: : Don’t mind her, Senpai. I’m doing fine and you can take all the time you need.
lines.zh: : 别理她，前辈。我挺好的，你想歇多久都行。

lines.en: : Though...it wouldn’t be a lie to say that I’d like you to hurry up if possible. Not because of work specifically, though. Just because I miss having you around.
lines.zh: : 不过……说实话，如果可以的话，我还是希望你快点回来。倒不是为了工作。只是因为我想有你在身边。

lines.en: : Now kiss.
lines.zh: : 现在亲一个。

lines.en: : {i}Please{/i} don’t mind her. I know you don’t see me like that and I’m seriously not trying to pressure you. In fact, this is kind of why I didn’t want you to come {i}at all{/i} and-
lines.zh: : {i}请{/i}别在意她。我知道你不是那样看我的，我也真的不是在施压。事实上，这也是我当初{i}不太想让你来{/i}的原因之一，而且——

lines.en: : You don’t want me here?
lines.zh: : 你不想我来？

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim14
: Wha- no! I just meant that, like...cause you are......and I am......and sex........soooooo yeah!
lines.zh: : 什么——不是！我只是说，那个……因为你是……然后我是……还有性……所、以、嘛，就是这样！

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim15
: Who wants a drink?!
lines.zh: : 谁要喝酒？！

lines.en: : You two go ahead, but do not even think of putting your hands on my seven. Or eight.
lines.zh: : 你们俩喝吧，但别打我那七瓶的主意。或者八瓶。

lines.en: : Fifteen or sixteen counting Osako’s, as she’ll be coming to the shower with me right after putting our luggage away.
lines.zh: : 算上 Osako 的那份，是十五六瓶——她放完行李就要跟我去洗澡。

lines.en: : Do you guys need anything from the lobby? Any snacks or...additional drinks if seven beers and one to two glasses of champagne isn’t enough for you?
lines.zh: : 你们需要从前台带点什么吗？零食什么的，或者……七瓶啤酒加一两杯香槟还不够的话，要不要再来点酒？

lines.en: : They sell contraception as well. Not that I’m sure either of you would bother using it.
lines.zh: : 那儿也卖避孕用品。虽然我不确定你们俩会不会费事去用。

lines.en: scene black
: Wakana, leave those two alone. If they want to have heterosexual sex together, let them have heterosexual sex together on their own terms.
lines.zh: : Wakana，别管他们俩。他们要是想跟对方做异性性爱，就让他们按自己的方式去做呗。

lines.en: : {i}Thank you,{/i} Osako! But...why did you have to be so specific?
lines.zh: : {i}谢谢你{/i}，Osako！不过……你非得说得这么具体吗？

lines.en: : Pay no mind to my cat. She’s been thinking quite a bit about heterosexual sex lately. Haven’t you, kitty?
lines.zh: : 别理我家小猫。她最近对异性性爱的思考频率相当高。是不是啊，小猫咪？

lines.en: : Wakana...{i}don’t do this....{/i}
lines.zh: : Wakana……{i}别这样{/i}……

lines.en: Wakana and Osako don’t stay in the room much longer.
lines.zh: Wakana 和 Osako 没在房间里待多久。

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim16
After grabbing their things, they exit the main hall and head to the showers, leaving Imani and me alone when I’m {i}pretty sure{/i} Wakana directly told me she’d stop doing this.
lines.zh: 她们拿上东西走出正厅去洗澡，把 Imani 和我单独留下——而我{i}敢肯定{/i} Wakana 亲口跟我说过她不会再这么干了。

lines.en: But at least Imani doesn’t seem to be completely taken off guard by it, so...I imagine she kind of knew this was coming.
lines.zh: 不过至少 Imani 看起来没完全被搞得措手不及，所以……我想她多少料到了会有这一出。

lines.en: And I imagine that’s what this whole trip is {i}for{/i} based on how we were immediately left alone next to a bottle of champagne with a huge heart on it.
lines.zh: 而我看得出这趟旅行的{i}用意{/i}——我们刚被单独留在一瓶印着巨大爱心的香槟旁边。
: 那个……

lines.en: : I’m...sorry about Wakana. She’s been kind of...{i}off{/i} lately.
lines.zh: : 关于 Wakana……我很抱歉。她最近有点……{i}不太对劲{/i}。

lines.en: : Off how?
lines.zh: : 怎么个不对劲？

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim17
: Uh...we kind of said we weren’t going to talk about that this weekend. But all you really need to know is she’s been...working kind of hard.
lines.zh: : 呃……我们说好这个周末不谈那个的。不过你只需要知道，她最近……忙得挺狠。

lines.en: : Like...really hard. And not just at school.
lines.zh: : 真的……很狠。而且不只是学校的事。

lines.en: : So {i}that’s{/i} why she’s decided to start trying to hook us up again? Because she’s...{i}off?{/i}
lines.zh: : 所以她{i}这才{/i}又开始撮合我们俩？因为她……{i}不对劲{/i}？

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim16

: Oh, I don’t think that’s it. I think that’s kind of just a...thing she’s doing to distract herself from the real reason we came all the way out here. You know...to like, keep the mood light and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 哦，我觉得不是。我觉得那只是她……拿来分散注意力的做法，好不去想我们大老远跑来的真正原因。就是……为了让气氛轻松点之类的。

lines.en: : Isn’t the reason we came all the way out here to enable one more situation for the two of us to finally sleep together?
lines.zh: : 我们大老远跑来的原因，不就是再造一次机会让我们俩终于能上床吗？

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim18
: What? No, that’s not it at all. And frankly, I didn’t really want to come either.
lines.zh: : 什么？不，完全不是。说实话，我自己也不太想来。

lines.en: : I’m...not sure I follow.
lines.zh: : 我……有点跟不上。

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim19
: {i}Wakana and Osako are kinda, like...fighting lately. And Osako threw this trip together to try and, like...put an end to that or something.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Wakana 和 Osako 最近有点……嗯，在闹别扭。Osako 搞了这趟旅行，想……怎么说呢，给这事画个句号之类的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Which is why I’m thankful you’re here since I didn’t want to be the third wheel. But I also feel bad about you getting dragged into it, so...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}所以我很庆幸你来了，因为我可不想当电灯泡。但你被拖下水我也挺过意不去，所以……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I guess let’s just...try and have some fun, okay? And not get in their way too much...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我想我们就……尽量玩得开心点吧，好吗？也别太碍她们的事……{/i}

lines.en: : Do you really need to keep laying the pressure on Imani like that? I thought the whole thing with her and Akira was, like...a sensitive topic?
lines.zh: : 你非得一直这么给 Imani 施压吗？我以为她和 Akira 那件事，是……一个敏感话题来着？

lines.en: : It’s only sensitive because Arakawa is a fucking coward who’s been habitually abused for so long that he wouldn’t know a “good” partner if they slapped him across the face.
lines.zh: : 之所以敏感，只因为荒川是个他妈的懦夫，长期被虐待惯了，就算一个「好」伴侣当面扇他一巴掌，他也认不出来。

lines.en: : Do good partners hit each other now?
lines.zh: : 好伴侣现在都互相打了吗？

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim20
: Sometimes. When the mood is right. Is {i}that{/i} what we should try to get me off next? Or do you still prefer the idea of me fucking someone else?
lines.zh: : 有时候会。看气氛。{i}这{/i}就是我们下次该试的助兴方式吗？还是你依然更想我去跟别人上床？

lines.en: : Wakana, I said I was sorry about that. I really don’t know what else I can do. But you haven’t been great either lately and you know it.
lines.zh: : Wakana，我说过那件事我道歉。我真不知道还能怎么办。但你最近表现也不怎么样，你自己清楚。

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim21
: Yes, it appears we’ve both been rather unpleasant as of late. Here’s hoping that fifteen or sixteen beers collectively can fix it.
lines.zh: : 是啊，看来我们俩最近都挺讨人嫌。希望那加起来十五六瓶啤酒能治好。

lines.en: : It’s less about the beer and more just about being here. It’s...weird going from having sex multiple times a day to barely ever at all.
lines.zh: : 与其说是啤酒，不如说是待在这儿这件事本身。从一天做爱好几次到几乎完全不做，这感觉……挺怪的。

lines.en: : Which is why we should focus our efforts on getting our friends to sleep together instead. They can prosper while the two of us only get wet while we’re showering together.
lines.zh: : 所以我们不如把精力放在撮合我们朋友上床这件事上。他们可以开花结果，我们俩就只在洗澡的时候湿一把。

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim22
: We could maybe, like...do it {i}here?{/i}
lines.zh: : 我们说不定可以……在{i}这儿{/i}做？

lines.en: : With people around? This is no train station bathroom, Osako. Getting caught here could put my career in jeopardy.
lines.zh: : 周围还有人呢？这可不是车站卫生间，Osako。在这儿被抓到，我的饭碗可能就砸了。

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim23
: I mean...so could fooling around in your office and we used to do that like every single week.
lines.zh: : 我是说……在你办公室里乱来也一样危险，我们以前可是每个星期都那么干。

lines.en: : I can lock my office. I can {i}not{/i} lock the outside world.
lines.zh: : 我的办公室能锁门。外面的世界我锁{i}不{/i}了。

lines.en: : If you don’t want to do it, just say so. You don’t have to beat around the bush.
lines.zh: : 你不想做就直说。不用拐弯抹角。

lines.en: : What bush? You shaved just yesterday, did you not?
lines.zh: : 什么弯？你昨天刚刮过毛吧？

lines.en: : Wakana-
lines.zh: : Wakana——

lines.en: : I don’t want to do it.
lines.zh: : 我不想做。

lines.en: scene wakanaseizehim24
: Is it...still because you’re mad at me?
lines.zh: : 是因为……你还在生我的气吗？

lines.en: : It’s nothing that exciting. My new medication is likely just sodomizing my libido. But in the less fun sort of way.
